fact: The National Statistics Council's 27 August 2026 session was to validate the project document, social-mobilisation communication document and resource-mobilisation strategy for the fifth General Population and Housing Census (CGPV-V) and hear progress on it as an operation under way.
Decree 25/2025 of 3 March orders the fifth General Population and Housing Census, with the census set for 2027 and preparatory work begun in 2024, per INEGE's director general.
The Scientific Committee validated the project document, communication strategy and resource-mobilisation strategy for the fifth census on 20 August 2026 (reported date).
INEGE's director general says the last population census was held in 2015, more than a decade earlier.
INEGE opened a 27-29 July 2026 workshop to validate the project document and mobilisation strategies for the fifth census, authorised by Decree 25/2025 of 3 March.
